assertions.name: at_lead_the_chain_misses_over_97_percent_of_proton_pairs
assertions.note: 2/Z captured -- 2.44 % at Z = 82. qou-nial's sum-vs-product as combinatorics: a path's edge count is LINEAR, Coulomb needs QUADRATIC, so no letter or scale can make a Z^2 term from Z-1 edges

assertions.name: a_paths_degree_deficit_is_constant_not_A_to_the_two_thirds
assertions.note: so no A^(2/3) piece can arise from the edge count of a path, for any letters. Coulomb and surface are ONE defect: a 1-D chain where the physics is a saturating 3-D packing

assertions.name: raw_all_pairs_differs_from_the_chain_by_a_factor_of_tens
assertions.note: 65x, not the 0.6 % I reported. Renormalising all-pairs to A-1 bonds threw away exactly the quadratic growth that distinguishes it, so that test could not have seen the effect. The claim 'the bond GRAPH is not where the error lives' is WITHDRAWN -- it is exactly where it lives. The ORDERING half (segregated vs alternating, both chains) is unaffected

assertions.name: coulombs_joint_contribution_is_not_negligible
assertions.note: it spans 67 % in B, against the marginal correlation of -0.044 this arc read as 'essentially absent'. Marginal correlations conflate collinear shapes -- heavy nuclei have large Z, large N-Z and large A together

assertions.name: the_ranking_is_three_to_one_point_eight_to_one_not_eighteen_to_four_to_one
assertions.note: the asymmetry is still largest, but far less lopsidedly than the marginals suggested

assertions.name: the_three_SEMF_shapes_jointly_explain_over_ninety_percent
assertions.note: the missing physics is not exotic and not unidentified -- it is the liquid-drop corrections in their standard forms, and two of the three follow from one structural fact about the edge set

parameters.note: the regression is a DIAGNOSTIC, never adopted as a law -- fitting three SEMF coefficients would reproduce the SEMF and prove nothing
